rationale: Optimal dispatch minimizes diesel cost by maximizing battery discharge when beneficial while respecting SOC bounds (2.5-8.0 MWh), diesel limits (12-55 MW), and serving all load. Battery schedule [8, 10, 8, 0] MW achieves minimum total diesel generation of 93 MW over the 4 intervals, yielding cost of 93 MWh * 0.08333 hr * $92/MWh = $713.
